## Summary

Fixes #1009 (`deploy:test_bdist_wheels_ga_cudnn_3.12:sm90` hanging on `test_bprop_fp8_thd[test52]`).

- **Root cause (backend, SM90 only):** the Hopper FP8 SDPA *forward* kernel never finishes when a whole Q tile has no valid keys. Two ways to get there in the fuzz suites:
  - `test52`: THD fp8 e4m3, b=2, GQA 3:1, d=64, s=6447, `seq_len_q=[5380, 5176]`, `seq_len_kv=[5175, 1307]`, TL band `left=1224 / right=2078` -- rows past `kv_len + left_bound` of batch 1 see no keys.
  - `test359` (found by running the whole suite on H100 with the first fix): **no window**, b=3, MHA d=128, `seq_len_q=[270, 6898, 1785]`, `seq_len_kv=[2022, 0, 540]` -- a zero-length KV batch.

  The hang is in the fwd `execute` + `synchronize` (fp8.py:596), not the bwd graph -- Hopper already declines fp8 ragged bwd. Reproduced with cuDNN 9.25.0.21 and 9.27.0.28; the identical configs pass in FP16 and on SM100.
- **Frontend gate:** `validate_sdpa_support_surface` now declines `SM90 && padding_mask && left_bound` for FP8 forward with `GRAPH_NOT_SUPPORTED`. Blackwell and FP16 are untouched.
- **Harness skip:** `test/python/sdpa/fp8.py` skips SM90 fp8 padded draws in which some batch has `seq_len_q > 0` and (`seq_len_kv == 0` or a TL left bound ending past its keys). `seq_len_kv == 0` is runtime data the frontend cannot see, so this cannot be a graph-level rule; the message names the issue.
- Adds `test/python/test_sdpa_fp8_hopper_padding_window_rejected.py` (validation-only, pins `pygraph(sm_version=90)` so it runs on any GPU; positive controls for no-left-bound / no-padding / SM100) and documents both limitations in `docs/operations/Attention.md`.

## Evidence (H100 NVL, FE develop `2a0343f07`, cuDNN 9.25.0.21 via LD_PRELOAD; fwd-only variants)

| variant | result |
|---|---|
| test52 as drawn | **hang** (>8 min; also hangs on cuDNN 9.27.0.28) |
| test52, no window (`left=right=None`) | pass 2.7 s |
| test52, dense (no ragged/padding), same band | pass 2.2 s |
| test52, equal per-batch lens `kv=[5175, 5176]` | pass 2.0 s |
| test52, `kv=[5175, 3200]` / `3000` (>= 1 full dead Q tile) | **hang** (3/3) |
| test52, `kv=[5175, 3900]` (52 dead rows, no full tile) / `4000` (none) | pass (one 4000 run took 47 s, then 2.3 s -> racy) |
| test52, left-only causal window (`right=0`) | **hang** |
| test52, right-only window (`left=None`) | pass 2.9 s |
| test52 in fp16 | pass 2.1 s |
| test359 as drawn (`kv=[2022, 0, 540]`) | **hang** (>25 min in the suite run, >150 s standalone) |
| test359 with `kv=[2022, 64, 540]` | pass 1.5 s |
| test359 in fp16 | pass 2.4 s |

With this PR, `test52` and `test359` skip on the H100 in 0.2 s (`SM90 FP8 forward hangs on query rows with no valid keys (...; GitHub #1009)`).

## Trade-off

The graph-level gate is broader than the trigger: it also declines Hopper FP8 padded/THD + sliding-window graphs whose batches all satisfy `seq_len_q == seq_len_kv` (self-attention), which run fine. FE cannot see per-batch lengths at plan time. Once the SM90 kernel is fixed in the backend, bound this rule by backend version and drop the harness skip.

## Test plan

- [x] `test_sdpa_fp8_hopper_padding_window_rejected.py` 5/5 on B200 (sm_version pinned) and H100
- [x] `test_bprop_fp8_thd[test52]` and `[test359]` on H100 + cuDNN 9.25.0: skip instead of hang
- [ ] full `test_bprop_fp8.py` + `test_context_fp8_thd*` + `test_generation_fp8.py` on H100 + cuDNN 9.25.0 (running; results in a comment)
- [ ] sm90 wheel job green on the mirror pipeline

**Codex bot review · model: `gpt-6-astra`**

Reviewed `d1313c048a17` against base `0ed2710bc6db`.

The conservative Hopper gate makes sense as a workaround, including the documented loss of otherwise-safe padded self-attention windows. No P0 or high-risk P1 found. Zero-KV runtime data remains a caller restriction, not a production runtime check supplied by this PR. I would tighten the three acceptance tests as already noted by CodeRabbit.

I do not consider [the skip-predicate comment](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/1069#discussion_r4013119994) a hang blocker here: TOP_LEFT equality with a left bound is rejected by the new graph gate before execute; BOTTOM_RIGHT with any right bound is already rejected for Hopper FP8 by validate_sdpa_support_surface. has_causal_mask_bottom_right() checks right_bound.has_value(), including positive bounds. Changing > to >= would make the early skip geometrically exact, but those configurations already cannot reach the kernel.

- **[P2] Still open:** [Require successful validation in the positive controls](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/1069#pullrequestreview-5206914513).

Validation: Reviewed all four changed files (113 additions), surrounding FP8/FP16 support gates, the harness graph-building/skip flow, diagonal-bound reference semantics and documentation. Clean merge onto develop 0ed2710bc6db. Compiled the real header against baseline 2a0343f079b0 and head d1313c048a17, with cuDNN 9.25.1 and CUDA 13.2. A 144-case validation-only matrix used explicit target SM90/SM100, E4M3/E5M2/FP16, padding on/off, left bound present/absent, right bound absent/0/128, and TOP_LEFT/BOTTOM_RIGHT. Normal implementation selection ran before support validation. Exactly eight cases changed from OK to the intended Hopper padding/window decline; the other 136 outcomes were identical. Baseline had 128 accepts/16 existing declines; head had 120 accepts/24 declines. The matrix confirms that positive controls are accepted and Hopper FP8 bottom-right/right-bound configurations already decline. The harness calls validate inside its unsupported-graph skip handler before launching forward. Requested python_tests CI and verified the mirrored full head equals d1313c048a17. Current-head Hopper development/release jobs are queued. The author reports a separate H100 sweep with no hang, 157 passed/1,696 skipped/3 dense numerical failures; that is author-provided evidence, not my independent rerun.

Limitations: No attention kernel was launched by the independent probes, and no known hanging case was rerun on a shared GPU. I did not rebuild/run the Python extension tests locally; the C++ probes directly exercise the changed header, and fresh-build Python CI is pending. No CPU/GPU performance benchmark: this changes validation and test skips, with no execute-path or kernel modification. The workaround has no backend-version upper bound until a fixed version is established.

Approved: no P0 or high-risk P1 found. Remaining findings stay with the owner; merge timing stays with the owner.

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Regression test for https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/issues/1009.
+
+The SM90 FP8 SDPA forward kernel hangs when a padding mask is combined with a
+left diagonal band bound and some batch has seq_len_q well above seq_len_kv
+(query rows whose whole window lies past that batch's keys). The per-batch
+lengths are runtime data, so ``validate_sdpa_support_surface`` declines the
+whole padding + left-bound combination on Hopper. The graphs here pin
+``sm_version`` so the check runs on any GPU; only ``validate()`` is exercised.
+"""
+
+import cudnn
+import pytest
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.L0
+
+_MATCH = "left diagonal band bound is not supported on Hopper"
+
+
+def _validate_fp8_fwd(*, sm_version, use_padding_mask, left_bound, right_bound):
+    b, h, s, d = 2, 4, 512, 64
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph(
+        io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3,
+        intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        sm_version=sm_version,
+    )
+    dim = (b, h, s, d)
+    stride = (h * s * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    q = graph.tensor(name="q", dim=dim, stride=stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+    k = graph.tensor(name="k", dim=dim, stride=stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+    v = graph.tensor(name="v", dim=dim, stride=stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+
+    def scalar(name):
+        return graph.tensor(name=name, dim=(1, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+
+    seq_len_q = seq_len_kv = None
+    if use_padding_mask:
+        seq_len_q = graph.tensor(name="seq_len_q", dim=(b, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+        seq_len_kv = graph.tensor(name="seq_len_kv", dim=(b, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+
+    o, stats, _amax_s, amax_o = graph.sdpa_fp8(
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        descale_q=scalar("descale_q"),
+        descale_k=scalar("descale_k"),
+        descale_v=scalar("descale_v"),
+        descale_s=scalar("descale_s"),
+        scale_s=scalar("scale_s"),
+        scale_o=scalar("scale_o"),
+        generate_stats=True,
+        attn_scale=1.0 / (d**0.5),
+        use_padding_mask=use_padding_mask,
+        seq_len_q=seq_len_q,
+        seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv,
+        left_bound=left_bound,
+        right_bound=right_bound,
+    )
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(dim).set_stride(stride).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+    stats.set_output(True).set_dim((b, h, s, 1)).set_stride((h * s, s, 1, 1)).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    amax_o.set_output(True).set_dim((1, 1, 1, 1)).set_stride((1, 1, 1, 1)).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    graph.validate()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("right_bound", [0, 128], ids=["causal_left", "band"])
+def test_hopper_rejects_fp8_padding_with_left_bound(right_bound):
+    with pytest.raises(cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError, match=_MATCH):
+        _validate_fp8_fwd(sm_version=90, use_padding_mask=True, left_bound=128, right_bound=right_bound)
+
+
+def _assert_not_our_rejection(fn):
+    try:
+        fn()
+    except cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError as e:
+        assert _MATCH not in str(e), f"wrongly rejected by the #1009 guard: {e}"
+
+
+def test_hopper_accepts_fp8_padding_without_left_bound():
+    _assert_not_our_rejection(lambda: _validate_fp8_fwd(sm_version=90, use_padding_mask=True, left_bound=None, right_bound=0))
+
+
+def test_hopper_accepts_fp8_left_bound_without_padding():
+    _assert_not_our_rejection(lambda: _validate_fp8_fwd(sm_version=90, use_padding_mask=False, left_bound=128, right_bound=0))
+
+
+def test_blackwell_accepts_fp8_padding_with_left_bound():
+    _assert_not_our_rejection(lambda: _validate_fp8_fwd(sm_version=100, use_padding_mask=True, left_bound=128, right_bound=0))

The SM90 FP8 fprop emitter advanced its Q ring-buffer cursor on every tile while only handshaking the slot when `kv_loop_left_bound < kv_loop_right_bound`; an empty Q tile (zero-length KV, or a left band bound past the keys) burned a slot without the consumer's `mma_q` arrive and the producer deadlocked on the slot's next reuse. Per direction, the FE should not switch the feature off; the gate/skip here should be dropped or version-bounded once !4489 lands.

The conservative Hopper gate makes sense as a workaround, including the documented loss of otherwise-safe padded self-attention windows. No P0 or high-risk P1 found. Zero-KV runtime data remains a caller restriction, not a production runtime check supplied by this PR. I would tighten the three acceptance tests as already noted by CodeRabbit.
